The check was widened to explicitly reject equality, and a boundary test (`JwtVerifierTest#expiredAtExactBoundary`) was added to prevent regression. This is a security-relevant boundary fix: an attacker presenting a just-expired token could previously gain access within the same clock tick.</narrative>
